adopted.statement: a = sqrt(8 pi) 3^{1/4} ell_P adopted as the canonical SI ruler (F79); F83 mass map demoted to consistency check.

L4a_exact_canonical_deflection.note: exact at ALL u: ln(e^{2u}) = 2u is exactly 1/r — the canonical form's straight-ray coefficient is 4GM/(bc^2) with no finite-field correction (corrections enter only through ray bending, L4b).

L4b_full_quadrature_canonical.note: canonical e^{2u} index: straight-ray K_bend is exactly -4 independent of u (L4a); quadrature confirms.

L4c_lattice_absolute.note: absolute lattice coefficient = 4 on the canonical K=e^{2u}; no stray sqrt(d) in the dimensionless coefficient.

L4d_si_g_match.note: lattice coefficient 4 (L4a-c) x F79 G(a) => 1.7512 arcsec at the solar limb — the measured value (VLBI/Cassini confirm gamma=1 to ~1e-4/1e-5).

grb_polarimetry_gate.note: F79 anchor: paired photon eta=0 (clears polarimetry), E_QG2 ~ 1.4e19 GeV >> 7e11 GeV (clears n=2 ToF by ~7 decades).  F83 ceiling anchor: E_QG2 ~ 4.7e2 GeV — excluded by ~9 decades.  The gate observationally selects a = 6.5978 ell_P.

f83_consistency.note: ceiling honoured by ~17 decades; electron m_lat ~ 1.6e-22 confirms the F12/F15 small-mass regime at the canonical a.
